body.statement: The certificates \((g_2,\pi_2)\) and \((g_4,\pi_4)\) are primal-dual saddles for both observation maps. In particular, \[\rho_2^{\mathrm{CR}}=\rho_2^W=\frac14,\qquad \rho_4^{\mathrm{CR}}=\rho_4^W=1-\frac{\sqrt3}{2}.\] Every response-type state outside the displayed prior supports has risk strictly below the corresponding saddle value under the displayed rule.
body.justification: The two smallest admissible populations establish that posterior relevance of the second count does not by itself imply minimax value.
body.gap: No located complete-randomization minimax paper reports unrestricted full-count and difference-only equality at these exact finite sizes.
body.consumer: The result provides regression tests for exact minimax implementations at the two smallest balanced sample sizes.
